_why: Two of the three Palomar submission failures were metadata that misdescribed the
declarations actually selected. Both were filing errors, not mathematics: the
submission form defaults the metadata path, and the plausible wrong answer sits in
the same directory as the right one. This file is the machine-readable pairing so
the correct path is derived rather than picked. scripts/palomar_precheck.py reads it
and refuses a comparator/metadata combination that is not listed here.
Adding a surface means adding a row here, deliberately.
Rows also carry the selected project dir, so no argument of a submission is chosen by hand.
